title: Insight Lab Public Engine Contract v1
description: Language-neutral, domain-neutral request and result messages exchanged over HTTP/JSON under /api/public/v1. This file is the single source of truth: the server, the Go SDK and the TypeScript SDK are checked against its $defs. A subject namespace or type is opaque metadata and never changes engine behavior.

Metadata.description: Bounded opaque string metadata. Keys match ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$. In document metadata, keys starting with public_ or analytical_ and the keys dataset_hash and acquisition_manifest are reserved: the engine records that provenance itself.

SubjectRef.description: Opaque external subject. Insight stores and echoes it but never interprets or branches on it.

externalRef.description: Caller's stable reference, unique within a subject.

AddEvidenceRequest.description: At least one document, analytical artifact or input source is required. Artifacts follow contracts/analytical-artifact/v1/schema.json.

AnalysisProvenance.description: The run's execution and input snapshots, verbatim. A snapshot the run never recorded is omitted, never sent empty.

quote.description: Exact text of the source document between startOffset and endOffset (rune offsets).

metrics.description: The run's recorded evaluation metrics, verbatim.

ObservationWindow.description: As-of boundary of a longitudinal iteration (#71). A later iteration may not use an earlier asOf than one already recorded.

AppendIterationRequest.description: Appends a new iteration evaluated on a completed analysis run. Earlier iterations are never modified.

artifact.description: The insight-lab.research-artifact v1 export of the latest iteration, verbatim. Its legacy analysisMode key means execution mode.

analyses.description: Every analysis run of the subject, oldest first.

RunComparison.description: Non-persistent comparison of two analysis runs of one subject (#83). It attributes a result delta to the input or execution axis. It never judges which run is better and never claims a cause.

explanation.description: The first entry always states that differences are not evidence of cause.

inputFingerprint.description: Absent when not recorded; never read as the same as another run.

executionFingerprint.description: Absent when not recorded; never read as the same as another run.

from.description: Empty when the field was absent.

to.description: Empty when the field was absent.

changes.description: Field-level diff: engineVersion, gitCommit, gitDirty, executionMode, semanticAnalysisMode, ruleVersions.*, promptVersion, promptFingerprint, provider, models.*, parameters.

delta.description: Null unless both runs recorded the metric.

variationKnown.description: False for a single run: variation is unknown, not zero.

source.description: Opaque name of the scheduler or person; never interpreted.

ReEvaluationRequest.description: Re-evaluate a research run because new evidence arrived (#74). analysisId names a completed analysis run over the new evidence. The engine schedules nothing itself.

correlationKey.description: Caller correlation id. Reusing it with the same analysisId returns ALREADY_EVALUATED; with another analysisId it is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

previousIterationId.description: Must be the latest iteration, otherwise STALE_ITERATION.

ReEvaluationRecord.description: Audit record attached to the iteration a re-evaluation created. Earlier iterations are never modified.

scope.description: Partial re-evaluation is not yet proven safe, so the whole iteration is re-evaluated.

status.description: NEW_ITERATION returns 201; the others return 200 and append nothing.

ResearchTimeline.description: Longitudinal read model of a research run (#71). Evidence/world changes and instrument (engine/model/prompt/rules) changes are separate arrays and are never merged. Derived from immutable iterations; historical entries never change when iterations are appended.

delta.description: Deterministic #70 Observation Delta, verbatim. Descriptive, never causal.

InstrumentChange.description: Execution fingerprint of consecutive iterations' analyses. UNKNOWN means not recorded, never SAME.

TemporalOperationRequest.description: Stateless #73 temporal operation. Nothing is stored; the derived artifact is neutral evidence that may later be submitted with addEvidence.

artifact.description: Derived insight-lab.analytical-artifact v1 (origin=derived, deterministic, provenance references the source artifact).

ExecutionProfile.description: Resource/runtime strategy (#91). Separate from semanticAnalysisMode, research stage and executionMode; it never changes hypothesis, validation or readiness semantics. Omitted means AUTO.

ExecutionProfileResolution.description: Which profile a run used and why. AUTO resolves deterministically from input shape; an unavailable profile fails with EXECUTION_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE instead of downgrading. Recorded in provenance.execution, not in the execution fingerprint.

RawArtifactRef.description: Reference to raw bytes held outside the engine. sha256 and sizeBytes are claims: the engine streams the bytes, measures them itself and rejects a mismatch with INPUT_VERIFICATION_FAILED. Supported URI schemes depend on the resolvers the engine is configured with (Core ships file:<relative path> under a configured root).

PreparationSpec.description: Declarative deterministic preparation of a raw CSV into an Analytical Artifact. Unknown fields are rejected. Sums are exact, so partitioned (HEAVY) and single-pass (STANDARD) preparation produce the same artifact.

InputSource.description: Additive input variant (#90). kind RAW_ARTIFACT registers an engine-verified reference. With preparation, the bytes are prepared into an Analytical Artifact when an analysis runs on STANDARD or HEAVY; without it the reference is recorded for provenance only and never analyzed as text.

TriageBucket.description: INCLUDE: deterministic processing should compute with the variable. DEFER: kept for later. NEEDS_REVIEW: definition or relevance unclear (UNKNOWN is preserved). EXCLUDE: a human chose not to process it; only HUMAN revisions may exclude and exclusion never deletes source data.

TriageClassification.description: Candidate research roles. Hypotheses about a variable, never causal findings.

sha256.description: sha256:<hex> of the profiled bytes. When sent it must match; responses always carry the engine-computed value.

CreateDatasetProfileRequest.description: Exactly one of csv (inline, at most 8 MiB) or documentId (an evidence document of the subject) is required.

DatasetProfile.description: Deterministic, bounded metadata. Identical bytes give an identical profileFingerprint. Raw rows are never stored or returned.

TriageRequest.description: researchRunId adds the unresolved ResearchGaps and DataRequirements of that run's latest iteration to gaps (re-triage).

triager.description: Default DETERMINISTIC. MODEL requires a configured model; its output passes the same normalization.

SelectionPlan.description: One immutable version. decisions lists every profiled column exactly once, in profile order. moves records how this version differs from its parent.

ScenarioBaseline.description: Observed baseline all scenarios branch from. asOf is required.

ScenarioHorizon.description: Forecast horizon of a scenario; end must be after the baseline asOf.

Assumption.description: A typed assumption. Only OBSERVED_BASELINE may cite evidenceRefs as observed fact; other kinds cite sourceRefs.

ValueRange.description: Optional numeric range for a RANGE expectation.

ScenarioExpectation.description: Frozen, falsifiable statement about a future observation.

provenance.description: ExpectationBasis (PRIOR, LITERATURE, DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE, MODEL_PROPOSED_POST_HOC, HUMAN_POST_HOC, DERIVED_FROM_PRIOR_RUN, OTHER, UNKNOWN). Post-hoc provenance is never treated as prior.

ScenarioProbability.description: Caller-supplied probability with its basis and sources. The engine never generates one.

Scenario.description: One possible future branch. At least one expectation must be testable after the baseline.

ScenarioRelation.description: Explicit relation between branches; scenarios need not be mutually exclusive.

ScenarioSet.description: Append-only scenario set version. Curating creates a new version.

ScenarioSetDraft.description: Scenario set submitted by a consumer; id, version and createdAt are assigned by the engine.

IndicatorObservation.description: A later observation for one expectation. CONSISTENT/CONTRADICTS require evidenceRef. Observations at or before the set was created cannot test it.

AssumptionCheck.description: Whether later evidence kept an assumption. INVALIDATED requires evidenceRef.

ScenarioState.description: Evidence state of one scenario at one evaluation.

status.description: Evidence state of a branch. Never a probability.

FiredFalsification.description: A falsification condition that fired on evidence.

from.description: Evidence state of a branch. Never a probability.

to.description: Evidence state of a branch. Never a probability.

ScenarioDelta.description: What new evidence changed. It ranks nothing and never names a most likely future.

ScenarioEvaluation.description: Append-only evaluation of one set version; carries forward earlier observations.

items.description: Scenario-specific DataRequirement, same shape as in the Research Artifact.

CreateScenarioSetRequest.description: Submit a curated scenario set as the next version.

ScaffoldScenarioSetRequest.description: Draft scenarios deterministically from an iteration's competing hypotheses. Baseline and horizon are required.

EvaluateScenariosRequest.description: Evaluate a scenario set version against new observations.

ScenarioAnalysis.description: Scenario history of a research run. Empty lists when none exist; scenarios are never synthesized.
